triage_candidates.statement: Latent-power training is NOT bit-reproducible run-to-run on torch 2.10 CPU even single-thread + fixed seed + PYTHONHASHSEED (~3e-4 weight drift; rank metrics swing O(0.1-0.3)). Orthogonal to run_jobs/utilization; means gold artifacts are not bit-stable across reruns generally. Needs a torch.use_deterministic_algorithms / deterministic-reduction investigation -> separate issue (HUMAN already approved filing 2026-06-03). This reframed-guarantee acceptance is the in-scope close.
